d:
Fast forward to November 2026, and Tesla has listed the Cybercab at **$29,990 — just $10 below the $30,000 mark!**
MKBHD has placed an order for the Cybercab but argues that the limited availability, delivery conditions and restrictions mean the challenge isn't settled yet. Meanwhile, Musk has called him a "chicken" on X.
In this video, we break down the entire MKBHD vs Elon Musk saga, including:
• What is Tesla's Cybercab and how does it work?
• What did Elon Musk promise at the 2024 We, Robot event?
• Why did MKBHD challenge Musk over the Cybercab's price?
